status: Reviewed BIOS CM paths operate USB4 adapter configuration; ASUS PD/retimer mode writer remains unlocated

native_control.callbacks_scope: Reviewed bodies log and close their event; no PD mode request or retimer I2C programming in those callback bodies. This is not a whole-firmware exclusion.
native_control.link_configure_scope: Native USB4 lane/adapter configuration: reads PORT_CS_19 at USB4 capability base+19 DWORDs, changes RS-FEC request bits1/2, invokes downstream port reset helper, then rereads adapter capabilities/link state. No PS8830 mode/orientation I2C write sequence identified in the reviewed routine.
native_control.reset_helper_scope: Sets and clears PORT_CS_19 bit0 using configuration packets; not USB-PD Enter_USB or a qualified repair request.
native_control.pei_entry_scope: The inspected core reads the platform support Boolean, selects diagnostic text and returns. It does not call a PEI USB4 manager or issue retimer-mode writes in this entry body. Helpers include logging/timing/service access; not a full firmware model.
native_control.independent_disassembly: RVA/file mapping crosschecked with raw bytes and raw-mode x86-64 disassembly for selected DXE ranges. TE entries decoded as IA32 with0x180 stripping correction.

bus_protocol_scan.positive_control: Bus providers, HID consumer and SMBus users/dependency sections match in the same corpus. Matches are references, not transaction measurements.

oem_candidate.finding: The reference is a notify-dispatch descriptor. Reviewed callback copies/installs configuration structures after dependency availability; the GUID match itself is not an SMBus Execute call or identified PS8830 transaction.

bus_protocol_scan.limit: Exact standard GUID search only. Private protocols, raw controller IO, SMU/EC paths, constructed identifiers and PD-private firmware remain outside this exclusion.

analysis_corrections: Initial Store Python scan could not see the AppData extraction directory and returned0files; rejected, not used as absence evidence. Native PowerShell scan verified2473files/63036796bytes.
Initial generic PE header probe was invalid for the IA32 TE modules; corrected from TE signature, machine and section header.
Initial automatic radare2 PE base shifted DXE addresses by10000hex; retained separately. Corrected raw-mode disassembly matches original RVA/file bytes.
A GUID pointer in OEM module data was initially inspected as possible code; section mapping identifies a notify descriptor instead.
Boot-service offset extraction initially omitted Reserved pointer; corrected44-pointer table yields CloseEvent70, LocateProtocol140, CreateEventEx170hex.
conclusion: The retained pre-OS CM code gives concrete USB4 adapter operations but does not supply the missing ASUS PD-to-APU/PS8830 mode sequence. The clear Windows RouterDetected bit is still not causally explained. No new boot is justified by the presence of this BIOS manager.
